verdict.rationale: Clerky's pricing page says founders can complete IRS forms and submit them to the IRS fully online, handled 100% in-house. That is consistent with filing for an EIN, but the evidence never names the EIN or Form SS-4, so the IRS filing feature could refer to other forms such as 83(b) elections. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that EIN/SS-4 filing is offered, details of the EIN application flow and turnaround, independent or hands-on confirmation of obtaining an EIN through Clerky.
